text:
Mira Chen: Quick heads-up — I'm starting onboarding for atlas-7b-open (community checkpoint). Need a license sanity check and perf profile before we add it to the catalog. @Sam can you take the license pass? :eyes:
Sam Patel: Yep. I'll triage the model license today. If it's compatible we'll mark it as "community-permissive" in the catalog. Any upstream attribution notes?
Mira Chen: Model card links in the PR: https://git.internal/redwood/models/pulls/328 — authors list + dataset README included. Flagging potential CC-BY subset usage.
Ani Reddy: Quick perf note — ran a short latency sweep on p4d-dev and got 110ms p50 for 512-context, throughput looks fine. Need a 1k-token tail run. Anything special about kv-cache footprint?
Leo Gomez: KV cache is standard for that architecture; quantized checkpoints add ~10% mem reduction. I can run the 1k token bench later today. Can someone drop the exact eval script?
Mira Chen: Eval script in the PR under /bench/atlas-7b/run_eval.sh. snippet:
```bash
./run_eval.sh --model checkpoints/atlas-7b --seq 1024 --batch 8 --out perf.json
```
Sam Patel: License quick note: model weights are MIT-like but training data includes CC-BY-4.0 items. Legal asked for a short writeup of downstream obligations. I'll ping Legal and post summary here by EOD.
Tanya Brooks: FYI product: we'll want a short blurb about expected cost tier (likely mid-tier) and whether to recommend hosted vs dedicated. cc @Mira Chen for numbers.
Mira Chen: Good call — early estimate: hosted ~0.8 tokens/sec on a single GPU instance cost similar to our other 7B family. I'll add cost table to the PR.
Ani Reddy: Action items: (1) @Sam legal summary, (2) @Leo full 1k-token perf + mem, (3) @Tanya product cost blurb, (4) me to add accuracy eval vs our reference prompts. I'll update the checklist.
Sam Patel: Legal acked receipt. They want a one-paragraph risk note and to know if any datasets are non-consenting. I'll confirm.
Leo Gomez: Running bench now, posting results in thread when done. ETA ~2h.
infra-bot: Deploybot: benchmark-run queued on p4d-bench-03 (job id bk-4421). Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/jobs/bk-4421
Mira Chen: small follow-up: who owns the catalog metadata entry? We should assign to an owner for post-launch maintenance. I'd propose @Tanya for product ownership and @Ani for infra/metric ownership. Thoughts?
Tanya Brooks: Happy to own product metadata and customer-facing blurb. I'll coordinate with Ani on tags and performance labels.
Sam Patel: Once legal sign-off is in the PR we can move to catalog-staging. I'd also like a short automated check to verify license header on model card — small GH action.
Mira Chen: Agreed. @Leo when bench complete can you paste p50/p95, mem, and a note if quantized run changed quality? If quality drop >1% we'll flag for optimization.
Leo Gomez: Done with initial run: p50=112ms, p95=230ms, peak GPU mem 38GB, quantized int8 run shows negligible quality change on our prompt set. Pasting full perf.json to PR. :thumbsup:
Mira Chen: Perfect. I'll update the PR checklist: license: pending (Sam), legal note: pending, perf: done (Leo), accuracy eval: in progress (Ani), product blurb: pending (Tanya). Targeting staging import by tomorrow afternoon.
Tanya Brooks: I'll draft the blurb and add recommended deployment tiers.
Ani Reddy: Accuracy eval running nightly across 3 prompt suites; posting regression alerts if any.
Sam Patel: Legal summary attached to PR now. Says OK to list with CC-BY attribution and disclaimer.
Mira Chen: Thanks everyone — leaving this thread as the single source of truth for onboarding. If anything blocks staging import, ping here and I'll re-prioritize. :sparkles:
